name: Auriferous-Verge
description: Heat is the local god. Fissures glow along every fault line, the air tastes of sulfur past geothermal vent fields, and by dark the ground itself still glows faintly, like a banked furnace.

The air carries dust and something faintly floral, and sound behaves strangely: footsteps crack loud, then die without echo. At night the temperature drops fast enough to hear the rock tick as it contracts.
Something about this world resists explanation. Every expedition answers three questions and returns with five better ones.
Every syndicate scout files the same advice: harvest fast, land light, and never spend a full cycle planetside. The wise ones follow it exactly once.
